stem:
In her home in Jaipur, Meena observes four changes.

| change | W | X | Y | Z |
| observation | ice cubes melting in a glass of water | an iron gate forming rust in the rain | tearing a sheet of paper into pieces | a log of wood burning in the stove |

Which changes are physical changes?

teacher.key_rationale: A physical change produces no new substance. Melting ice (W) and tearing paper (Y) leave the material unchanged, so they are physical. Rusting (X) forms a new substance (rust) and burning wood (Z) forms ash, smoke and gases, so both are chemical. Therefore the correct pair is W and Y, option C. Option A traps a learner who treats rusting as merely a change in appearance; option B pairs the two chemical changes; option D pairs one physical with one chemical change.
